caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with three main sections. The top section consists of three square panels, each adorned with symmetrical, stylized floral or foliage carvings in a reddish-brown hue, bordered by greenish outlines. Dividing the panels are thin vertical elements that resemble turned wooden spindles, also in dark brown. On the left and right sides of the top section, there are decorative elongated shapes resembling balusters. Below this, there are two wide horizontal drawers, each with inset rectangular panels outlined in a darker brown shade and embellished with oval-shaped knobs. The drawer faces are decorated with rectangular and hexagonal shapes, maintaining the same reddish-brown and dark brown color scheme. Four straight, sturdy legs support the chest, matching the wood tones of the primary structure. The sides of the chest show additional paneling and decorative elements, repeating the spindle and panel motif found on the front. The overall color palette is mainly brown, with variations in shade to suggest different types of wood and carved details. The background is a plain, light beige, and there are no other objects or elements depicted around the chest.
title: Chest
